messages:
tess: Quick sync — proposing a small change to our client-facing error contract so SDKs can more reliably distinguish 'server-side queueing' from 'hard throttles'. Currently we return 429 for both and clients can't make good retry/backoff choices.

mike: +1 on wanting more signal. Can you sketch the payload you have in mind? Also need to think about how Console/Telemetry surfaces this.

tess: Idea: keep HTTP 429 but add a structured `error.code` plus `error.metadata.retry_after_ms` and `error.metadata.mode` where mode ∈ ["throttle","queue","degraded"]. Example: 

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate.limit.queue",
    "message": "Request queued due to burst capacity limits",
    "metadata": {"retry_after_ms": 1500, "mode": "queue", "quota_bucket": "user-global-30m"}
  },
  "trace_id": "r-0a1b2c3d"
}
```

tess: This preserves 429 semantics but gives clients actionability (short retry for queue, long backoff for throttle). Also gives Console exact breakdown by `mode`.

anya: That makes sense. A couple concerns: i18n for message text (we should avoid clients showing raw message), and SDK behavior — we want default SDKs to auto-retry for `mode==queue` but not for `throttle`. Agree?

sam-g: Agreed re i18n. SDKs should map `error.code` to enums and only surface friendly strings via the Console copy or localized catalog. Auto-retry policy: queue -> exponential jittered retry up to X ms; throttle -> surface retry_after if provided.

oliver: From routing side, we get a lot of transient queueing when a model variant warms up. If we add `quota_bucket`, that will help attribute cost and create better telemetry. But we need to ensure this doesn't become high-cardinality in metrics. Suggest we limit `quota_bucket` values to canonical names (route id, model family).

mike: Telemetry: we should add a dimension `error_mode` to the ingestion pipeline and tag traces with `route_id`, `model_variant`, `quota_bucket`, `fallback_reason`. That'll let Dashboard show time-series for queue vs throttle. We need to coordinate with Observability to add a new pre-aggregated metric `requests.queue_rate`.

tess: For rollout: propose a canary where we emit `error.metadata.mode` for 10% of 429s for 1 week, surface counts in the eng-platform Console dashboard, and then flip on SDK mapping. Can we use the existing rollout flag `err_contract_v2`?

infra-bot: deploy:flag set err_contract_v2 -> 10% to eng-prod at 2026-03-21T09:30Z (canary id: rc-429-queue).

sam-g: Nice. When can we get an SDK PR? I can help with Node + Python. Need a clear mapping doc and tests showing behavior for `mode==queue` vs `throttle`.

tess: I'll draft the mapping doc this afternoon. Quick decision needed: do we use `mode` string or an integer code? Strings are friendlier for debugging; ints are compact. Leaning strings. Any objections?

mike: strings fine. Add a short header `X-Redwood-Error-Code: rate.limit.queue` so clients without JSON parsing can still route.

anya: And ensure Console rollout UX shows a migration note and a sample error payload in the API docs. Also add a note under Quotas page explaining `queue` vs `throttle` so customers can tune autoscaling/policies.

oliver: Will add `quota_bucket` canonicalization on our side. Also we should cap possible unique values and document allowed pattern.

tess: Great — action items:
- tess: write mapping doc + example payloads (today)
- infra: enable canary flag (thanks infra-bot)
- sam-g + anya: SDK changes PRs (week)
- mike: create telemetry metric + dashboard tiles for `error_mode` (this week)
- oliver: reduce quota_bucket cardinality and publish allowed list (week)

mike: I'll stub the dashboard and ping Observability for pre-agg quotas.

anya: One more: for Console error viewer, let's add a quick copy toggle so support can copy raw payload instead of localized string. Saves digging when debugging.

tess: Love it. If nobody objects, I'll open a 1-page RFC in docs repo and tag eng-platform + devex. :thumbsup:

oliver: No objections. :+1:

sam-g: :+1: — will start an SDK branch once mapping doc lands.

infra-bot: deploy:flag update err_contract_v2 -> 10% at 2026-03-21T09:31Z (canary active).

mike: Thanks all. Small follow-up: add `trace_id` in payloads (tess had it) — make it mandatory for any 429 with metadata so we can correlate logs.

tess: Good call, adding mandatory `trace_id` and noting that it must be returned in both HTTP header `X-Redwood-Trace` and JSON body for quick correlation.

mike: ok closing thread, will follow up on dashboard PR.
